Met ons geavanceerde Warehouse Managemen: With our advanced Warehouse Management System (WMS), all your assets are digitally registered and managed for real-time monitoring and control. Het meubelpaspoort is een essentieel ins: The Furniture Passport is an essential tool within our sustainable approach at De Bresser. This passport documents all relevant data for a piece of furniture, such as material composition, year of production and any maintenance history. This gives our customers full insight into the origin and life cycle of their furniture, allowing them to make well-informed decisions about reuse, repair or recycling. By integrating the Furniture Passport into our asset management process, we strive for a circular economy in which value is preserved and waste is minimised.
